items.q: It was Johnny Hodges and I that went to that little cafe in St. Louis and brought Blanton to the Chase Hotel in St. Louis and we said, Ellington, listen to this fellow.

ctx.x: I see. You mentioned Jimmie Blanton. You were there when Jimmie Blanton joined the band, right?
